types.label: value.title
types.note: A document is a VIEW over facts — it holds only {title, summary}. Membership + order live entirely in `_doc/<docId>/<factKey>` decorations (type doc-order); a member can be ANY fact (a doc-block, a canvas `el:`, a `cell:`, a claim), so 'blocks ARE facts' (no graduation). There is no inline block array — order is one fractional-seq write per decoration.

types.label: value.id
types.note: The DEFAULT type for prose authored directly in lit (markdown + lit fences) — a convenience, NOT a requirement for doc membership. A doc is a view over facts, so any fact of any type becomes a block when a `_doc/<docId>/<factKey>` decoration places it (lit renders it via its own type's renderer). Reach for doc-block only when minting fresh prose with no better home.

types.label: value.seq
types.note: Ordering decoration. Key `_doc/<docId>/<blockKey>`; the key-encoded rule (ADR-0003) projects it into a `block inDoc doc:<docId>` Reference edge — doc membership as graph.

schema.seq: number — narrative position (fractional, e.g. 2.25, allows insertion)
